package.description: Groeneveld service software for configuring and diagnosing automatic lubrication system controllers.

en-GB.description: Groeneveld service software for configuring and diagnosing automatic lubrication system controllers.
en-GB.longDescription: PC-GINA is the Groeneveld service software for the GINA controllers of automatic lubrication systems. Used together with the PC-GINA interface kit, it lets service technicians configure system parameters and read diagnostic data from the lubrication unit from a PC.
en-GB.name: Groeneveld PC-GINA 4.8
